fittingPromptSummary: Identity-preserving edit of each canonical 4x4 atlas. Add only a navy sleeveless knit sweater vest with a shallow cream ribbed V-neck and navy ribbed hem. Preserve all 16 poses, identity, hair, accessories, arms, wrist hooves, legs, feet and tails; no sleeves or undershirt.
itemExtractionPromptSummary: From each worn fitting atlas, retain only the registered vest pixels on transparency. Preserve perspective, armholes and occlusion; remove the character and background debris.
inventoryPromptSummary: Create a clean transparent front-view product cutout of the referenced vest, retaining navy knit and cream trim while raising the V point to the upper third of the chest.
runtimeSourceDecision: The generated garment-only studies were rejected as runtime sources because they enlarged the garment and reconstructed occluded regions. Runtime sources are deterministic character-fitted extractions from the worn references.
